##### Project general facts

The Yards Plaza is a commercial development by Beyond, bringing together a set of office blocks and a retail volume as a single architectural composition. A strong monolithic form, glass façades and aluminium louvers create a continuous design language across the blocks, while the façade filters daylight into shifting patterns of light and shade. At ground level the architecture opens up to a landscaped public realm, and generous office lobbies set a refined sense of arrival.

A landscaped central courtyard connects the blocks, with shaded seating, planting and pedestrian routes forming a shared outdoor space for meetings and breaks. Podium terraces extend the workplace outdoors, and a dedicated business centre offers an additional setting for teamwork beyond the office floor. Membership-based padel courts, a gym and a lap pool support wellbeing throughout the working day, while round-the-clock security with managed access keeps the development protected.

The offices are delivered in shell-and-core condition, giving businesses the freedom to design their own fit-out, from open-plan studios to executive meeting rooms. Shared interiors combine stone flooring, feature stone and timber wall finishes, artwork, feature lighting and integrated wayfinding, while abundant natural light and clear views give the common areas a sense of openness. Retail and dining spaces line the active edges of the development, adding everyday convenience for the working community.

##### Location description and benefits

City of Arabia is a district of Dubai positioned directly on Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. The district sits close to IMG Worlds of Adventure, one of the city's leisure destinations.

Global Village, Dubai Miracle Garden and Hamdan Sports Complex are all within a short drive, while Silicon Central Mall and Mall of the Emirates provide shopping within reach.

Business hubs and transport links are reachable by road, with Downtown Dubai reached via Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and both Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport connected to the district. Ownership in the area is freehold, making the district a convenient base for businesses that need access to several parts of the city.
